simple.meaning: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רוּם (H7311) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 193 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רוּם (rûwm) means to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: 1Chr 15 16.
